news.headline: Wells Fargo Maintains Equal-Weight on ExxonMobil Holdings, Raises Price Target to $189
ExxonMobil Increases Stakes in Rovuma LNG and Papua LNG Projects
news.summary: ExxonMobil has reached agreements to increase its ownership in the Rovuma LNG project in Mozambique to 50% and the Papua LNG project in Papua New Guinea to 34%.

news.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for ExxonMobil
news.summary: Several financial institutions, including Bernstein, Morgan Stanley, and HSBC, have updated their price targets for ExxonMobil shares.
